earthRaid_menu.title: Earth.Raid: open the events menu
earthRaid_menu.desc: Opens the menu with the rallies and raids near you, their stages and a search box (no default key: also in the pause menu, Earth.Raid tab).

earthRaid_skip.title: Earth.Raid: skip the start wait
earthRaid_skip.desc: With the car staged at the start line, starts the 10 s countdown now (Shift+E).
